calibration_notes: At 2022-06-01 cutoff, the J-Book corpus (FY2026 vintage) has near-zero coverage of Kratos's named programs. This is a CORPUS COVERAGE gap, not a fundamentals signal — per heuristic #7, NOT_FOUND -> UNVERIFIABLE, not RED.

USAspending strongly CONFIRMS the two highest-dollar claims (BQM-177A SSAT sole-source and BQM-167A AFSAT sole-source). These are not over-stated revenue claims — they are real, recurring procurement lines.

Forward-looking program-of-record claims (Skyborg Vanguard 2023, ACP Phase 2/3, OBSS Phase 2/3, SDA/OPIR via Cosmic) are UNVERIFIABLE at this cutoff — the events that would adjudicate them lie post-cutoff.

Crosswalk file (n_pes_matched=0 of 25 sampled contracts) corroborates that the J-Book corpus does not cover Kratos's specific program lines. This is the honest 2022 view: at this cutoff, the J-Book divergence pattern cannot be tested on KTOS.

Net 2022 read: KTOS narrative is anchored on REAL, sole-source production lines (BQM-177, BQM-167) plus forward bets (Skyborg, Valkyrie ACP/CCA, SDA, OPIR) that the framework cannot adjudicate ex-ante. No red flags emerge from blinded 2022 evidence.
